why_material: The pre-R1 Part-1D-A regional crop/restore helpers did NOT reproduce the frozen Phase-12 square-crop + zero-padding semantics. Because regional probability maps are composed into the fusion field, a wrong map-back would have silently corrupted the primary PREDICTED_REGION_FLOAT_GLOBAL_RETAINED variant BEFORE any inference was ever run.

pre_r1_defects.defect: resized the 512x512 probability map DIRECTLY to the CLIPPED native rectangle (size=(clip_h, clip_w))
pre_r1_defects.required_by_protocol: 512 -> FULL square side (torch bilinear, align_corners=False) -> strip pad_* -> place at clip coords, i.e. Phase-12 restore_float
pre_r1_defects.consequence: interpolation grid misaligned whenever pad_top/pad_bottom/pad_left/pad_right is non-zero; zero-padded margin pixels wrongly interpolated INTO the valid region

pre_r1_defects.defect: cropped the valid native region and resized it directly to 512x512 without zero-padding to the square side
pre_r1_defects.required_by_protocol: valid -> zero-pad to FULL square side -> 512 BILINEAR -> [0,1], i.e. Phase-12 crop_tensor
pre_r1_defects.consequence: regional model input geometry differed from the Phase-12 oracle path it is compared against

pre_r1_defects.defect: reduced each frozen geometry record to clip coordinates only
pre_r1_defects.required_by_protocol: preserve the COMPLETE frozen record: y1/y2/x1/x2, clip_*, pad_*, crop_side, effective_magnification, margin
pre_r1_defects.consequence: faithful Phase-12 reproduction was IMPOSSIBLE from the parsed record alone

pre_r1_defects.defect: no validation that a frozen geometry satisfied the square/pad contract
pre_r1_defects.required_by_protocol: fail loudly on any malformed geometry rather than silently mis-map
pre_r1_defects.consequence: a malformed record would have produced a silently wrong map-back

repairs_applied.change: preserves ALL square/pad fields and normalises crop_side_pixels -> crop_side as a lossless alias; int-casts every coordinate field; performs NO additional margin operation
fail-loud checks: y2-y1 == crop_side; x2-x1 == crop_side; non-negative clip origin; clip within native bounds; vertical pad invariant; horizontal pad invariant; margin == frozen 0.20
valid native region -> zero-pad to FULL square side -> 512 BILINEAR -> /255.0 [0,1]; raises if the padded shape != crop_side

512 -> FULL square side via torch.nn.functional.interpolate(mode='bilinear', align_corners=False) -> strip pad_top/pad_bottom/pad_left/pad_right -> valid crop; returns (valid, (clip_y1, clip_x1, clip_y2, clip_x2)); raises if the restored extent != clipped extent. FLOAT only, no uint8 quantisation.
Phase-12 restore_float shape: full native array, zeros outside the clip
each 512 map is now restored through the square/padding path before the regional maximum is taken
deleted; no direct 512 -> clipped-rectangle shortcut remains anywhere in the module

materiality_measurement.method: compared the pre-R1 direct-resize restore against the repaired Phase-12-equivalent restore over ALL 494 frozen Part-1C proposals, using a synthetic random 512x512 probability map

interior_geometries.note: for interior crops clip extent == crop_side, so both paths resize to the same target and agree exactly

materiality_measurement.conclusion: the defect is MATERIAL: 2 of 494 frozen proposals would have been map-backed with up to ~0.88 probability error, with a direct effect on the 0.5-threshold binarisation feeding the fused field

geometry_availability_finding.finding: the COMPLETE square/pad geometry IS physically available in the frozen Part-1C table column proposal_crop_geometry
geometry_availability_finding.consequence: no re-derivation of geometry is needed; the frozen record is sufficient for faithful Phase-12-equivalent reproduction

equivalence_evidence.method: direct numerical comparison against the authoritative read-only Phase-12 helpers in notebooks/phasewise/phase_12_oracle_roi/code/phase12_oracle_inference.py

U top-edge padded crop equals Phase-12

Z padded square dims equal crop_side
AA valid restored extent equals clipped extent
